[[51 BBY/Legends|51 BBY]]<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' places the events of ''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Defenders of the Dead]]'' at [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]]. ''Defenders of the Dead'' indicates that at that time, [[Nield]] is approximately the same age as [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], who is stated to be thirteen years old on the back cover of ''Defenders of the Dead''. ''The Defenders of the Dead'' lists four battles that affected [[Nield]]'s childhood. The [[Unidentified battle (Micae's death)|first one]] is identified as occurring when Nield was five years old and therefore in approximately [[52 BBY/Legends|52 BBY]], the [[Unidentified battle (Leidra's death)|second]] is noted to be one month after the first, and the [[Battle of Zehava (Nield's cousin's death)|fourth]] occurs when Nield is eight (c. [[49 BBY/Legends|49 BBY]]). This article describes the third battle, for which the only indication of time is a statement that Nield had "a few peaceful years" between this battle and the fourth. Dictionary.com [http://dictionary.reference.com/browse/few defines] "few" as being "not many but more than one", so at least two years must elapse between this battle and the fourth, but this one cannot occur before the first two. Therefore, this battle must take place no earlier than immediately after the second battle, but no later than one year after that battle and two years before the fourth.</ref>

{{Quote|Then the Melida invaded his village. His cousin escaped and took him to Zehava.|Cerasi, recounting Nield's childhood to Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="JA5p65" />}}
In the late 50s [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the [[Melida/Legends|Melida]], one of the two [[Melida/Daan Civil War|warring]] factions on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Melida/Daan/Legends|Melida/Daan]] along with the [[Daan (people)/Legends|Daan]], '''invaded''' the [[Nield's village|village]] where the Daan child [[Nield]] was living with [[Nield's cousin|his cousin]] at the [[Time/Legends|time]]. His cousin escaped the village, taking Nield with her to the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Zehava]].<ref name="JA5p65" /> Later, in [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]],<ref name="ERCp33">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> Nield's friend [[Cerasi]] would recount the struggles of his childhood, including this battle, to [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]].<ref name="JA5p65" />

==Behind the scenes==
This battle is briefly mentioned in the [[1999]] young readers book [[Jedi Apprentice: The Defenders of the Dead|''The Defenders of the Dead'']], the fifth entry in [[Jude Watson]]'s [[Star Wars: Jedi Apprentice|''Jedi Apprentice'']] young readers series.<ref name="JA5p65" />
